content.scenario: A consumer rights organization wants to spread awareness about consumer rights and unfair trade practices. They approach the Central Authority for guidance.
content.outcome: The Central Authority may inquire or cause an inquiry or investigation to be made into violations of consumer rights or unfair trade practices, and may also file complaints before the District Commission, State Commission, or National Commission, as per the provisions of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: How can I spread awareness about consumer rights?
What is the role of the Central Authority in protecting consumer rights?
What can I do if I suspect unfair trade practices?
